items.rationale: Writing pen, eraser and ruler are familiar school stationery in the selected senses; a cup is a drinking vessel. A cup being usable at school does not make it stationery. The exact group is broad enough to include drawing and erasing without falsely calling all three ink-writing instruments. No hidden-definition dependency or plausible equally strong intruder exists among these four.

Frying pan, cooking pot and serving bowl are all vessels that contain food; the knife cuts food and is not a vessel. The common kitchen setting gives a meaningful thematic contrast, and the label correctly avoids claiming the serving bowl must be heated. Checked dictionary definitions match the exact KG identities.

Truck, minibus and van are road motor vehicles in their displayed everyday senses; the train travels by rail. Cargo versus passengers would not separate the intended group because each can carry either in some configuration. The exact road predicate supplies the honest distinction. Historical alternate senses of dubă do not displace the selected common vehicle sense.

The four intended relationships are distinct and familiar: hen produces egg, electric household lamp uses a light bulb, soup is served with a spoon, and an airport supports aircraft. The corrected final predicate describes transport infrastructure rather than conflating an airport with one terminal. Chicken/egg could both connect to soup as ingredients, but those associations do not provide a competing complete four-pair partition; the matched tool/product pairs remain substantially stronger. Lamp is read in its ordinary electric household sense, without a universal claim about oil lamps.

Tooth/toothbrush, mop/floor, tree/root and shopping/shop are factual anatomy-use, cleaning-use, part-whole and activity-location associations. The word root can also describe part of a tooth, but taking that association leaves no equally defensible complete partition for tree and toothbrush. Shop is one ordinary place for purchases; the label does not exclude markets or online shopping. All selected senses are familiar and exact.

School/learning, clock/minute and flower/flowerpot are practical associations. The corrected flower predicate explicitly says the pot is for its plant, preserving the exact reproductive-organ identity instead of relabeling it as a whole ornamental plant. Carrot/rabbit is accepted only as a familiar cultural association, evidenced in primary Warner Bros material and ordinary rabbit association; the text does not call carrots a staple, favourite or nutritionally complete food. RSPCA guidance was checked separately to avoid endorsing that misconception. No competing full partition among these eight is comparably direct.

scope: Exact corrected six-board raw factual/editorial review; primary original dictionary entries and original institutional material checked where named. Every displayed identity and competing on-board semantic association considered. Independent graph/novelty verification against all381 old boards is supporting evidence, not proof of human uniqueness. Final generated catalog and live API review remain separate.
